verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a public REST API with scoped API-token creation and permission groups. A live probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json. The full API (2,500+ endpoints, explicitly including Workers) is also exposed to agents via the Code Mode MCP server, which accepts API bearer tokens for automation and is itself confirmed live by probe. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving Workers specifically through the REST API, and explicit evidence of Workers-specific endpoints such as script upload or deploy.
